name: polyomics-search
description: Search public PolyOmics polymer simulations and interpret approved aggregate Sim2Real evidence when the server provides it.

interface.longDescription: Find, compare and shortlist simulated polymers with the public PolyOmics MCP server. Interpret approved aggregate Sim2Real evidence when available; individual experimental values and predictions are outside its scope.
defaultPrompt: Find PolyOmics polyimides with high simulated thermal conductivity and cite the dataset revision.
PolyOmicsでポリイミドを検索し、密度と熱伝導率を単位付きで比較して。
